description: Coastal Community Resilience Planning Guide — Louisiana is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA, National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration; Louisiana Sea Grant; University of New Orleans | Center for Hazards Assessment Response and Technology. This guide helps coastal communities envision what a changing climate means for the community and to lay the foundation for developing strategies to address emerging challenges. The guide uses free online tools and datasets to step users through a risk and vulnerability assessment for their coastal community. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal, High Winds, Erosion and Shoreline Recession. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
